title: Sary-Mogol
text:
Sary-Mogol is a small town in the valley between the Alay and Pamir mountain ranges, close to the Chinese and Tajik borders.

During peak season, many hikers stay in Sary-Mogol, but during the four days we spent here, we only saw a couple of other tourists.

Walking through the village, kids would constantly run up to us to say hello. One girl gave Grace a small bunch of flowers and a firm handshake. On two separate occasions, groups of girls also came up to Grace and presented her with a kitten to pat.
